note: TEST-PHASE CONFIG: every level at which something unlocks. Robot blueprints (incl. crafted extra units) and player skills. Edit freely while testing: the game reads this file at start, and a test build also reads an edited copy placed next to the exe (WorkshopWreckage_Data/../unlocks.json) without a rebuild. A release build (WW_RELEASE) compiles the values in and ignores external copies. debug_mode: shows the 'DEBUG: unlock now' button at the Robot Workbench (also --debug on the command line); ignored in release builds.

robot_upgrades.note: Earliest player level per rank of a robot intelligence upgrade (design v1.0 §6.2); upgrades not listed are open from level 1.

skill_tuning.note: Usable skills: 'slot' is the number key (1-9) that uses it. Per-level values are lists, one entry per skill level (the last entry also covers higher levels); a single number applies to every level. Cooldowns in seconds start when the skill does something.
